params.body:
Shane, 21 September 2026, asked whether own vehicles should always come first: "ja eigen wagens altijd bovenaan!"

Nothing to build. That is what the code does, and has done since 16 September (commit `910207bb`, PR #502), five days after this finding was written. `applyWebsiteVehicleDefaultOrder` applies `ownFirstSql` before the branch that sorts on internal number, so the grouping also holds for a dealer who does not use internal numbers, and `PublicVehicleController` applies the same expression on `scope=all`, on by default, with `own_first=0` for whoever wants one continuous list.

So the finding is closed on the code that already answered it, with the decision recorded.

What it shows is that a finding can go stale itself. This one described behaviour that had not existed for five days and was still standing as a question for the customer. A finding deserves a re-read at the moment it is decided, not only at the moment it is written.

Fixes bevinding eigen-wagens-staan-altijd-bovenaan-op-de
Fixes #590
params.title: Own vehicles first already holds
